Class ScenarioSimulationLauncher

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.scenario.ScenarioSimulationLauncher
public class ScenarioSimulationLauncher extends Object
Controller managing deferred H3 hexagonal planetary generation, clipping boundary filtering, simulation thread launch, and background calculation progress monitoring.

Handles asynchronous threading transitions between JavaFX Application Thread and the background generation executor, ensuring deterministic grid initialization and progress bar updates.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
